papers.title: Pailitao-MMSearch: Building Native E-Commerce Multimodal Search Foundation
papers.authors: Xiaohan Ye, Xu Chen, Zihan Gong, Jian Ding, et al.
papers.score_reason_zh: 电商搜索主链路强相关，方法完整覆盖表示、持续训练与复杂意图推理，并给出很强的线上业务增益，因此列为今日最高优先级论文。
papers.score_reason_en: Highly relevant to the core e-commerce search stack, with a complete representation / continual-training / reasoning pipeline and strong online business gains.
papers.method_zh: Pailitao-MMSearch 用 HybSID 同时保留离散语义ID与连续多模态表示，再通过两阶段持续预训练接上电商域知识，最后用混合推理后训练提升复杂搜索意图下的检索质量。高光点在于把理解、推理和检索合并到同一个电商原生系统里。
papers.method_en: Pailitao-MMSearch combines discrete semantic IDs and continuous multimodal embeddings through HybSID, adapts the model with two-stage continual pretraining, and applies hybrid post-training for complex search intents. Its key highlight is a native e-commerce pipeline that unifies understanding, reasoning, and retrieval.
papers.innovation_zh: HybSID、持续预训练防遗忘机制，以及和复杂意图推理联动的后训练，是这篇论文最有价值的三点创新。
papers.innovation_en: Its most valuable innovations are HybSID, anti-forgetting continual adaptation, and post-training that directly links complex intent reasoning with retrieval.
papers.metrics_zh: 论文报告在线 A/B 中 GMV 提升 13.61%，成交笔数提升 8.21%；离线评测在电商理解和检索任务上显著优于通用基线。
papers.metrics_en: The paper reports +13.61% GMV and +8.21% transaction volume online, with strong offline gains on e-commerce understanding and retrieval tasks.

papers.title: MMRM: A Multiplex Multimodal Representation Model for Product Ranking in E-commerce Search
papers.authors: Zhen-Lin Chen, Maosen Sheng, Peng Lin, Jianmin Chen, et al.
papers.score_reason_zh: 与电商搜索排序和内容分发直接相关，线上指标扎实，方法对多行为目标建模有较强参考价值，因此进入高分与复现名单。
papers.score_reason_en: Directly relevant to e-commerce ranking and content distribution, with solid online metrics and strong value for multi-behavior modeling.
papers.method_zh: MMRM 在共享多模态骨干上引入任务 token，为点击、加购、下单等目标生成多路 multiplex item representations，再结合行为序列得到对应的 multiplex user representations 做多任务排序。亮点在于一次前向就能得到多种行为语义的商品表征。
papers.method_en: MMRM introduces task tokens on a shared multimodal backbone to generate multiple behavior-aware item representations, then derives matching multiplex user representations from behavior sequences for multi-task ranking. Its highlight is one-pass generation of several item semantics aligned to different behaviors.
papers.innovation_zh: 共享骨干+任务 token、多路 multiplex item representation 的一次生成、以及和用户行为序列耦合的 multiplex ranking，是这篇论文的核心创新。
papers.innovation_en: The core innovations are task-token conditioning on a shared backbone, one-pass multiplex item representations, and multiplex ranking coupled with user behavior sequences.
papers.metrics_zh: 论文报告在京东线上 A/B 中 UCTR 提升 0.42%，UACR 提升 0.37%，UCVR 提升 0.35%；离线检索与排序指标也整体优于对照方法。
papers.metrics_en: The paper reports +0.42% UCTR, +0.37% UACR, and +0.35% UCVR online at JD.com, along with consistent offline ranking gains.

papers.title: RuleSafe-VL: Evaluating Rule-Conditioned Decision Reasoning in Vision-Language Content Moderation
papers.authors: Zhifeng Lu, Dianyuan Wang, Yuhu Shang, Zhenbo Xu
papers.affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
papers.score_reason_zh: 直接命中达人治理和多模态违规审核的核心痛点，虽然更偏 benchmark 与评测，但规则链条视角非常有价值，因此给出 80+。
papers.score_reason_en: It directly targets core governance pain points in multimodal moderation. Although benchmark-oriented, its rule-chain perspective is highly valuable.
papers.method_zh: RuleSafe-VL 把平台审核政策形式化成原子规则和规则关系，并拆成激活规则识别、规则关系恢复、证据充分性判断和上下文补全决策四类任务。高光点是把“最终标签是否正确”升级为“规则推理过程是否正确”。
papers.method_en: RuleSafe-VL formalizes moderation policies into atomic rules and relations, then evaluates rule activation, rule recovery, evidence sufficiency, and context-aware decisions. Its highlight is evaluating whether the reasoning process is correct, not only the final label.
papers.innovation_zh: 把审核政策提升成结构化规则图，并显式考察关系推理和证据充分性，是它最值得借鉴的地方。
papers.innovation_en: Its most important contribution is turning moderation policies into a structured rule graph and evaluating relation reasoning plus evidence sufficiency.
papers.metrics_zh: 在 2,166 个图文审核案例上，最佳模型在规则关系恢复上 Macro-F1 仅 64.8，在决策状态预测上也只有 64.5。
papers.metrics_en: On 2,166 moderation cases, the best model reaches only 64.8 Macro-F1 on rule-relation recovery and 64.5 on decision-state prediction.

papers.title: ParVL: Parallel Scaling and Expandable Compute Allocation for Multimodal LLMs
papers.authors: Yang Yang, Qinyu Zhao, Mouxiang Chen, Xiaohui Li, et al.
papers.affiliations: ANU, Shanghai AI Lab, Zhejiang University, SJTU, Nanjing University
papers.score_reason_zh: 是 2026-08-05 当天的高热多模态论文，方法对视觉/语言算力配比很有启发，但与电商内容治理仅弱相关，因此不进入复现名单。
papers.score_reason_en: A high-heat paper released today with strong insights on vision/language compute allocation, but only weakly related to commerce governance, so it is not reproduced here.
papers.method_zh: ParVL 用共享骨干的并行视觉/语言分支来扩展多模态模型计算量，并允许灵活分配视觉和语言计算预算。亮点是把‘计算如何在视觉和语言之间分配’变成显式可调的设计变量。
papers.method_en: ParVL scales multimodal models with parallel vision/language branches over a shared backbone and allows flexible compute allocation between modalities. Its highlight is making vision-language compute allocation an explicit design variable.
papers.innovation_zh: 共享参数的并行分支、可调算力配比和很低的参数增量，是它最值得关注的创新。
papers.innovation_en: Its most notable innovations are shared-parameter parallel branches, adjustable compute allocation, and small parameter overhead.
papers.metrics_zh: 1B 规模下 9 项基准平均分从 49.6 提升到 50.5，数学推理从 26.0 提升到 28.0，batch-1 延迟约为单分支的 1.04 倍。
papers.metrics_en: At 1B scale, the average over nine benchmarks rises from 49.6 to 50.5, math reasoning goes from 26.0 to 28.0, and batch-1 latency stays around 1.04× the baseline.

papers.title: Video-DeepResearch: Towards the Next-Generation Multimodal Deepresearch Agent
papers.authors: Zhen Fang, Yu Zeng, Wenxuan Huang, Yiming Zhao, et al.
papers.affiliations: USTC, Xiaohongshu, CUHK, Zhejiang University, UCLA
papers.score_reason_zh: 虽然不是纯电商论文，但与达人短视频/直播治理的迁移价值很高，且是 2026-08-05 当天最值得关注的视频 Agent 热点之一。
papers.score_reason_en: Not a pure e-commerce paper, but highly transferable to creator short-video and livestream governance, and one of the most notable video-agent releases of the day.
papers.method_zh: Video-DeepResearch 先强制做跨帧视觉锚定与关键帧分析，再解锁网页检索和外部知识使用，训练上结合 SFT 和 GRPO。高光点是把视频理解、工具调用和开放式检索真正连成一个闭环 agent。
papers.method_en: Video-DeepResearch enforces cross-frame visual grounding before web exploration, then combines supervised tuning with GRPO for tool-using reasoning. Its key highlight is an end-to-end agent loop over video perception, tool usage, and open-web search.
papers.innovation_zh: 视频版 deep research agent 的流程设计、阶段式工具解锁，以及用强化学习提升多步工具调用质量，是它最亮眼的创新。
papers.innovation_en: Its strongest innovations are a video-native deep-research workflow, stage-wise tool unlocking, and reinforcement learning for multi-step tool usage.
papers.metrics_zh: 35B 版本在 VideoDR-Bench 上平均准确率达到 64.0%，超过 Claude-4.5-Sonnet 的 59.0% 和 GPT-5 的 52.5%；30B 版本也达到 59.3%。
papers.metrics_en: The 35B model reaches 64.0% average accuracy on VideoDR-Bench, beating Claude-4.5-Sonnet at 59.0% and GPT-5 at 52.5%; the 30B version still reaches 59.3%.
